images.note: Real Microsoft screenshot of the PivotTable ribbon's Calculations group, showing the 'Fields, Items, & Sets' button — the actual menu path to Calculated Field.
Real Microsoft screenshot of a Values-field context menu with 'Value Field Settings...' highlighted — the alternate route to a custom calculation on an existing field.
Real Microsoft screenshot of a PivotTable showing values displayed as '% of Grand Total' — a built-in computed display, the same category of result a calculated field produces.

imageNote: All three images verified as genuine Excel screenshots from Microsoft's official PivotTable calculation support pages (support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/media/). No screenshot of the literal 'Insert Calculated Field' text-entry dialog was found on Microsoft's site after a broad search; the ribbon path to reach it (Fields, Items & Sets) and the equivalent Value Field Settings route are shown instead, and the formula-entry step itself is covered as an original code card, honestly labeled as such.
